I suggest you to try to keep the Israeli citizenship. You are literately one step away. Based on my understanding once you get your israeli citizenship, you can live abroad for as long as you want. 

I suggest you to delay your job start date with your new job or try to fly back for the loyalty ceremony.  Since you got accepted into this new job, it means you qualify for this type of role. The career opportunity don't go anywhere - it costs an employer on average 10k USD to hire for a role. I have negotiated my start date in the past and know many people who negotiate to start multimonths later (usually due to visa issues). Also work is tricky - you might find out that you don't like the new country or the new role. So I suggest to maximize your opportunity
